title: Uniqueness of the normalized rational partial closed datum
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l with its specified valuation ring and uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme W on which l is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the rational tensor, admissible Hom pairs and internal-Hom object of [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations], the partial closed interface of [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces], and the integral partial closed datum of [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps]. Any two rational partial closed data whose inverse transposes send every pure tensor a tensor f to a tensor the prescribed integral inverse transpose of f are equal. No rational-linearity assumption on these data is needed: their additive inverse transposes are determined on the tensor-product generators.

proof.text: Use the prescribed rational internal-Hom object equality to identify each incoming Hom module with the tensor product of the localization ring and the integral Hom module. The given normalization identifies the two inverse transposes on all pure tensors. Additivity and tensor-product induction identify them on every arrow.

Equality of inverse additive equivalences gives equality of the forward equivalences by injectivity of the inverse. Apply extensionality of partial closed data; the remaining naturality fields are propositions.

lean.statement:
theorem podRationalClosed_unique
    (S S' : PodPartialClosed (rationalDerivedTensor l E W)
      (constructibleRationalHomPairs l E W) (rationalDerivedInternalHom l E W))
    (hS : ∀ (L : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E W)
      (P : (constructibleRationalHomPairs l E W).FullSubcategory)
      (f : L.obj ⟶ (constructibleIntegralHom l E W).obj
        (integralPairOfRationalHomPair l E W P))
      (a : Localization.Away (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E))
      (q : L ⟶ (rationalDerivedInternalHom l E W).obj P),
      HEq q (a ⊗ₜ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E] f) →
      HEq ((S.transpose L P).symm q)
        (a ⊗ₜ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E]
          ((podIntegralClosed l E W).transpose L.obj
            (integralPairOfRationalHomPair l E W P)).symm f))
    (hS' : ∀ (L : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E W)
      (P : (constructibleRationalHomPairs l E W).FullSubcategory)
      (f : L.obj ⟶ (constructibleIntegralHom l E W).obj
        (integralPairOfRationalHomPair l E W P))
      (a : Localization.Away (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E))
      (q : L ⟶ (rationalDerivedInternalHom l E W).obj P),
      HEq q (a ⊗ₜ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E] f) →
      HEq ((S'.transpose L P).symm q)
        (a ⊗ₜ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E]
          ((podIntegralClosed l E W).transpose L.obj
            (integralPairOfRationalHomPair l E W P)).symm f)) :
    S = S'
